```ts
import { ProfilePatch } from './types';

const MAX_DISPLAY_NAME = 40;
const MAX_TAG_LENGTH = 12;
const MAX_TAGS = 5;

export function parseProfile(input: unknown): ProfilePatch {
  if (typeof input !== 'object' || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) {
    throw new Error('invalid profile');
  }
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(input) as object | null;
  if (proto !== Object.prototype && proto !== null) {
    throw new Error('invalid profile');
  }

  let displayName: ProfilePatch['displayName'] = { kind: 'keep' };
  let tags: ProfilePatch['tags'] = { kind: 'keep' };

  const names = Object.keys(input);
  let displayNameKey = false;
  let tagsKey = false;
  for (const key of names) {
    if (key === 'displayName') displayNameKey = true;
    else if (key === 'tags') tagsKey = true;
    else throw new Error('invalid profile');
  }

  if (displayNameKey) {
    const value = (input as { displayName?: unknown }).displayName;
    if (value === null) {
      displayName = { kind: 'set', value: null };
    } else if (typeof value === 'string') {
      const trimmed = value.trim();
      if (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME) throw new Error('invalid profile');
      displayName = { kind: 'set', value: trimmed };
    } else {
      throw new Error('invalid profile');
    }
  }

  if (tagsKey) {
    const value = (input as { tags?: unknown }).tags;
    if (value === null || (Array.isArray(value) && value.length === 0)) {
      tags = { kind: 'set', value: [] };
    } else if (Array.isArray(value)) {
      if (value.length > MAX_TAGS) throw new Error('invalid profile');
      const seen = new Set<string>();
      const cleaned: string[] = [];
      for (const raw of value) {
        if (typeof raw !== 'string') throw new Error('invalid profile');
        const tag = raw.trim();
        if (tag.length === 0 || tag.length > MAX_TAG_LENGTH) throw new Error('invalid profile');
        if (seen.has(tag)) throw new Error('invalid profile');
        seen.add(tag);
        cleaned.push(tag);
      }
      tags = { kind: 'set', value: cleaned };
    } else {
      throw new Error('invalid profile');
    }
  }

  return { displayName, tags };
}
```

```ts
import { ProfilePatch } from './types';

const DISPLAY_NAME_MIN = 1;
const DISPLAY_NAME_MAX = 40;
const TAGS_MAX_COUNT = 5;
const TAG_MAX_LENGTH = 12;

function invalid(): never {
  throw new Error('invalid profile');
}

export function parseProfile(input: unknown): ProfilePatch {
  if (typeof input !== 'object' || input === null || Array.isArray(input)) invalid();
  if (Object.getPrototypeOf(input) !== Object.prototype && Object.getPrototypeOf(input) !== null) invalid();

  const record = input as Record<string, unknown>;
  let hasDisplayName = false;
  let hasTags = false;
  for (const key of Object.keys(record)) {
    if (key === 'displayName') hasDisplayName = true;
    else if (key === 'tags') hasTags = true;
    else invalid();
  }

  let displayName: ProfilePatch['displayName'] = { kind: 'keep' };
  if (hasDisplayName) displayName = parseDisplayName(record.displayName);

  let tags: ProfilePatch['tags'] = { kind: 'keep' };
  if (hasTags) tags = parseTags(record.tags);

  return { displayName, tags };
}

function parseDisplayName(value: unknown): ProfilePatch['displayName'] {
  if (value === null) return { kind: 'set', value: null };
  if (typeof value !== 'string') invalid();
  const name = value.trim();
  if (name.length < DISPLAY_NAME_MIN || name.length > DISPLAY_NAME_MAX) invalid();
  return { kind: 'set', value: name };
}

function parseTags(value: unknown): ProfilePatch['tags'] {
  if (value === null) return { kind: 'set', value: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) invalid();
  if (value.length === 0) return { kind: 'set', value: [] };
  if (value.length > TAGS_MAX_COUNT) invalid();

  const tags: string[] = [];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  for (const entry of value) {
    if (typeof entry !== 'string') invalid();
    const tag = entry.trim();
    if (tag.length === 0 || tag.length > TAG_MAX_LENGTH) invalid();
    if (seen.has(tag)) invalid();
    seen.add(tag);
    tags.push(tag);
  }
  return { kind: 'set', value: tags };
}
```

**`src/parser.ts`** — rewrote `parseProfile` (same public signature `(input: unknown) => ProfilePatch`) to enforce the PATCH contract:

- **Shape validation**: rejects arrays, `null`, primitives and functions, and additionally rejects any object whose prototype is neither `Object.prototype` nor `null` (class instances, `Object.create(protoWithProps)`, etc.). Key presence is decided on **own enumerable keys** via `Object.keys`, so `Object.prototype` pollution and inherited properties are never read.
- **Unknown keys**: any key other than `displayName`/`tags` throws `Error('invalid profile')`.
- **displayName**: absent → `{ kind: 'keep' }`; `null` → set `null` (clears); string → trimmed, and the trimmed value must be 1..40 characters, stored trimmed; anything else (`undefined`, numbers, booleans, objects) → invalid with **no coercion**.

A brand-new array is built, never the caller's.
- **Atomicity**: all validation happens during parsing, so an invalid input throws before the service touches any field.

**`src/service.ts`** — `ProfileService.patch` now applies the parsed keep/set fields: only `set` fields are written, so absent fields retain stored values, `{}` is a valid no-op, and it returns the resulting stored profile.
